title: Veterans Claim Evidence Navigator
tagline: A status update helps only when it preserves the evidence and review path.

cards: The status alone appears to explain what happens next.
Some uploads are visible in one channel but not another.
Ask for the whole file again
Repeated evidence burdens the claimant and obscures receipts.
The navigator preserves a human-owned benefits decision.

story.headline: The evidence request for a document already filed
beats: A Veteran sees a claim waiting in evidence gathering.
The file and status tool expose different subsets of supporting records.
A generic request recreates the claim file and still may use the wrong channel.
The exact map identifies one gap and routes accredited review without rating.
